_about: Routing eval set for the SPINE router experiments (E1). Written 2026-09-22 by the experimenting agent, NOT mined from real sessions (this Mac has 9 sessions, too few). Two tiers: 'easy' = the request naturally names a distinctive noun that also appears in the SPINE line; 'hard' = the request announces the action in the user's own words with the SPINE's distinctive nouns deliberately avoided or aliased. Leakage risk is real for the easy tier — that is why the lexical control arm exists.
